nativeGroups.readOrder: Refresh parameter/frame state; authored-node and optional dependency reads are bypassed only when the stored exclusion flag is set. Finish by marking cached state and conditionally notifying a retained interface.
Walk retained parent nodes until a non-null companion is found; return the node/companion pair or zero pair.

Uncached policy walks the retained node hierarchy. Policy3 queries a node virtual method and becomes1 or2. Cache mode in low3 bits, result in bits3..6 and cached bit7. Cached reads reproduce both fields.

Dispatch initial refresh or cached incremental refresh through the embedded owner interface. Convert stored level to linear gain, multiply retained gain and compare against the engine threshold. The parameter refresh return is not a readiness result.
Update pending parameter maxima and clear dirty bits; preserve the cached path when no records are dirty.
Multiply per-record gains and retained factors; clamp below zero and store effective gain.
If a retained observer exists, tail-dispatch its notification interface; otherwise return.
Walk parent pointers until a policy override is found or the root is reached; write3-bit mode and return4-bit policy.
Multiply native frame quantum by look-ahead plus one, scale by owner rate, round by sign and compare the signed owner frame counter strictly below the result.
Read the one-shot frame clip and reset it to all ones.
Atomically drain the supplied context array in reverse index order. Only state43 contexts are sampled; run optional effects, context samples, retained envelope consumer and one-shot owner clip.
Read the current wrapper owner; optionally publish marker notification, query one-shot clip and restrict valid frames; no clip leaves the buffer unchanged.
Walk retained routing nodes and their fixed-stride rows; publish the exact address of the context PCM descriptor into each row.

Collect sample/end descriptors from the global context array. Zero unused tails in each planar channel, promote valid count to capacity, publish the descriptor into routing rows, release associated frame records and dispatch native filter processing.
Classify channel/filter state into bounded index lists, dispatch six filter kernels and update filter transition state. Classification and supplied buffer lifetime precede any sample operation.
Update two filter controls, compare previous and target values and classify flags into the corresponding native kernel lists.
Refresh first filter coefficients only under dirty/control flags; otherwise return the existing bypass bit.
Refresh second filter coefficients only under dirty/control flags; otherwise return the existing bypass bit.
With present input rows, clear all output channels and set valid count to capacity, then traverse the native input-row mask; no input rows return zero valid frames.

Traverse the occupied row mask. Read each source descriptor and gains; matching channel layout, no matrix/transition and constant gain use the additive scalar kernel; other layouts need allocated matrices and the matrix consumer.
Select the existing CPU implementation for constant gain addition; fallback uses the scalar/SSE body.

With zero second factor, add source multiplied by constant gain into existing destination, in vector groups. Nonzero second factor tail-dispatches another kernel; tiny gain leaves destination unchanged.
Selected CPU implementation of the constant-gain additive operation; available CPU flags, scalar count and padded readable input are conditions.
Allocate the built-in sink through the supplied plugin allocator and tail-call its constructor; null allocation returns null.
Install the built-in sink address point, initialize retained buffers/flags and an original OS critical section; this does not initialize an audio endpoint.

Prepare main and optional auxiliary sink buffers from incoming PCM and gain pair. Matching rate/no matrix uses native channel conversion; optional ring, matrix and resampler paths remain conditional. Mark input present.
Without an auxiliary matrix, copy the typed input descriptor and dispatch native channel-layout conversion into the output descriptor. Matrix mode allocates/uses separate temporary state.
Map source/target channel masks and mode to a native conversion table slot and tail-call the selected function with the same typed descriptors and gain pair.
Populate conversion-table pointers and select supported CPU implementation; this initializer does not create an audio endpoint.
Native stereo planar-to-interleaved conversion with gain factors. The initialized channel table selects this body for the admitted matching-stereo copy cohort.

Query current audio-client padding and context state. For supplied matching-rate input, submit valid prepared frames. Without input, request/release a silent buffer. Preserve optional resampler/ring/error handling and clear input-present bit. The admitted non-resampling input branch does not inspect submission/release HRESULT and clears input-present after the call; copied bytes do not establish OS acceptance.

Call retained render client GetBuffer for valid frames; copy channel-count times valid-frames float bytes, then ReleaseBuffer with flags0. Generic error or null buffer does not release and marks the sink invalid; AUDCLNT_E_BUFFER_TOO_LARGE consults context status before deciding the invalid flag. The release result has no local success/error comparison after the virtual call.
Configure an audio client and acquire the render service using the binary IID into the retained render-client field; endpoint/format/initialization results remain required conditions.
Select/prepare the output bus buffer. Single matching-layout input uses its gain path, other layouts use native bus mixing, then forward the resulting descriptor to the output consumer.
Apply output gain factors, visit secondary outputs and taps, then forward PCM to the retained sink interface; extended-layout path passes main/aux descriptors, metadata and gain pair.
Find the first exact full sink plugin ID in32-byte registry rows, call its registered factory, attach typed settings and return construction status. Missing registry entry yields distinct status.
Initialize context descriptor, retained links and embedded pipeline interfaces; this is distinct from attachment and native frame preparation.

Read native owner format, allocate frame metadata, optionally construct the frame processor, collect effect stages when permitted, initialize filter state and envelope/pipeline links and retain the resulting format. Authored parameter/effect collection disabled is an explicit cohort condition.
The stored exclusion flag returns no effect collection; otherwise query the retained authored node through its effect interface.
Retain the primary owner, set first-frame flags and tail-call frame-converter setup with the same format and selected engine rate.
Read format metadata from the linked source interface and update frame-converter channel state if present.
Initialize fixed-point position and mode, rate ratio, channel history pointers and first-pitch flag.
Read packed source channel configuration and sample width, allocate or embed channel history, compute source-to-engine rate ratio and frame mode.
Compute fixed-point step from pitch and rate ratio, retain target/current step and select copy, interpolation or transition mode.
Dispatch on stored converter mode/sample layout; consume input frames until the supplied output limit or input exhaustion, preserving fixed-point state.
Initialize frame conversion table entries and choose available CPU kernels. No endpoint or sample computation is initialized by this table setup alone.

Hold incoming source descriptor, allocate output with native buffer framing, emit conditional initial zeros derived from owner frame offset, then convert/aggregate source blocks into the requested output frame. Preserve partial input and output between calls.
Retain requested frame capacity, update pitch through the linked source, and return pending frame data or final state before requesting more source samples.
Release the retained output buffer through the original frame-buffer release method, clear its descriptor and reset the output offset. Omitting release can replay the same cached frame.
Forward frame release through the embedded context pipeline interface.
If a linked stage exists, tail-dispatch that stage release interface; otherwise return.
Release the native reference-framed sample allocation through its checked header and pool/allocator path; stored channel count and supplied buffer lifetime remain conditions.
Allocate filter coefficient/history storage from the packed channel count and install its two history pointers. A bare zero-filled placeholder is insufficient for channel-bearing bypass processing.
For bypassed channel frames, retain final channel samples in both native history arrays and copy samples only when input/output pointers differ.
Zero each planar channel from valid count to capacity and promote valid count to capacity; require correctly populated channel configuration and readable padded allocation.
Apply constant or changing per-frame gain independently to planar channels using supplied valid count and capacity; preserve selected LFE handling.
Native constant-gain operation for one supplied channel span.
Native no-rate-change frame conversion consumes source blocks into the output limit and advances valid counts/positions; channel layout and allocation capacity are preconditions.

Publish retained channel configuration and native quantum into the caller descriptor; apply nonnegative initial frame-counter correction and route/gain/policy preparation. The admitted empty-route cohort executes the whole body and supplies scheduling/topology separately; authored nonempty route ownership remains open.

Original primary construction calls this embedded-owner constructor. Initialize parameter/interface storage, retain the passed authored node, derive the exclusion/dirty flags from the constructor input and node flags, and acquire game-object/node references. The primary constructor remains owned by the existing source transport contract.

Current SDK-named device bypass update walks the published output list through next+0x18, compares output/device ID fields+0x28/+0x20, and forwards the matching node to its update helper. This supplies the static output-list global identity; it does not establish live registry lifetime or selected output ownership.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected installed triplet, full exception/unwind extents, completely covered bounded leaves, current direct call/tail edges, existing codec group ownership, source-owned embedded address-point slots, current field operands, sink interface bytes and render-service IID. Constructor/table and direct caller joins select identities when short code shapes are ambiguous.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The checked primary constructor calls the embedded-owner constructor, and checked owner table slots select parameter refresh and gain routines. Current policy/gain/frame consumers read their declared fields. Current context construction/start and frame preparation/conversion/release carry native descriptors and frame counts. Frame-conversion dispatch reads the table written by its current initializer. The current before-sample routine tail-dispatches sampling after pitch preparation. Checked bus-row traversal uses its selected matrix-interface slot and additive gain path; master output forwards to the selected gain/padding/output consumers. Sink construction installs its checked input/frame-end table; format/interleave/submission routes include the checked render-client service IID and buffer/release calls.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Bounded anonymous owner/frame/routing fields and static transport, not complete SDK class layouts, authored bus ownership or runtime pointer generations.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: These are static routes under selected branches, readable supplied objects, successful allocation/provider/header/preparation and selected virtual interfaces. Current register allocation, table identities and tail calls were re-derived. Historical prepared-PCM, bus-sum and modeled-COM cohorts were not rerun or promoted by this static port.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Current PCM/output parity, actual voice admission and authored parameters/effects, live routing topology, non-bypass pitch/filter/rate/transition behavior, endpoint acceptance, concurrent lifetime/teardown and audibility.
